# sailpoint_entitlement (Data Source)

Data source for SailPoint Entitlement. Look up an entitlement either by `id`, or by any combination of `name`, `value`, `attribute` and `source_id`. The two lookup modes are mutually exclusive, and a filter lookup must match exactly one entitlement.

Filter lookup is how you reach entitlements ISC generates for you, such as the one created for an `INTERACTIVE_PROCESS` launcher (named after the launcher), without hardcoding a tenant-specific ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `attribute` (String) The entitlement attribute name. When set without `id`, filters the lookup on an exact match.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the entitlement. Mutually exclusive with the filter arguments.
- `name` (String) The entitlement name. When set without `id`, filters the lookup on an exact name match.
- `source_id` (String) The ID of the source the entitlement belongs to. When set without `id`, restricts the lookup to that source.
- `value` (String) The entitlement value. When set without `id`, filters the lookup on an exact match.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_governed` (Boolean)
- `created` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `manually_updated_fields` (Map of Boolean)
- `modified` (String)
- `owner` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `privileged` (Boolean)
- `requestable` (Boolean)
- `segments` (Set of String)
- `source` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source))
- `source_schema_object_type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
